title: A Portrait for the Winter
author: Casper Amberdale
blurb: Astrid Dravenmoor, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must finish the ritual the founders started before the well refills.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
